notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Another thank you to everyone for your continued support. We have been made aware of another bug, and we have a new hotfix coming in shortly to address it.


 Removed a debug key (B) that would allow the player to become a frog at the start of the game and break the sequencing.


To report an issue, you can find our bug report form here:
Bug Report Form

Alternatively, you can find and contact us here:
Linktree

Ribbitingly yours,
Skuxx Games 🐸💚

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has played Bask so far, we appreciate your reviews and feedback. A few issues have been brought to our attention, and the team has been busy at work resolving them today!


 Improved the Mugworts portal restoration hitbox
 Reduced the ambiguity around the Abandoned Sanctuary portals and how to activate them
 Added some new dialogue to help the player get to Alecost
 Increased POI particle render distance
 Notes will no longer despawn after being collected
 Fixed some visuals around the Mugworts bridges
 Fixed the lighting in the Abandoned Sanctuary, when a player loads a save created inside the forest. Note - if you load into a save at the Sanctuary and it is dark, simply enter the cabin and continue the quest. The lighting will be fixed when you exit the cabin.
 Added the ability to continue dialogue with Spacebar or E.
 Ending a dialogue is now more snappy and responsive.


We have also created a bug report form that you can use to share any issues with us:
Bug Report Form

Alternatively, you can find and contact us here:
Linktree

Thank you for your support!

Ribbitingly yours,
Skuxx Games 🐸💚

notes.title: Bask: The Alchemist Frog Releases on Steam!
notes.content:
Greeting and salutations!

Today's the day! After many moons of development, our small-team indie project is finally ready to leap onto your screens! 

Bask: The Alchemist Frog releases today on Steam for free!

We'd like to give a huge thanks to all of our playtesters, our mentors, and our followers. Your enthusiasm kept us hopping! While it may be a bit rough around the edges, we hope you enjoy what we have created and put out into the world as a labor of love (and learning).

Please bear in mind that the game is considered complete; while we'd love to keep expanding Bask's adventures, this marks the end of active development. What you see is the full, final experience we set out to create.

Here's to cozy adventures, magical mishaps, and the joy of exploring the weird and wonderful world of Bask: The Alchemist Frog. Thank you for playing!

Ribbitingly yours,
Skuxx Games 🐸💚
